title: The Voice of the LORD in the Storm
summary: The psalm calls the heavenly beings to ascribe glory and strength to the LORD. It then describes a thunderstorm sweeping in from the Mediterranean, in which the voice of the LORD thunders over the waters, breaks the cedars of Lebanon, shakes the wilderness, and strips the forests, while in his temple all cry glory. The LORD sits enthroned over the flood as King forever, and he gives his people strength and peace.

from.where: The Study Bible's notes on Psalm 29
from.text: The psalm is a hymn in three movements

line: The voice of the LORD thunders over the waters and breaks the cedars; God sits enthroned over the flood, and he gives his people strength and peace.
guide: Let creation make you small in a good way; when a storm shakes the windows, pray verse 3. Notice the ending: the God of the thunder uses his strength to give strength and his power to give peace.

stanzas.title: The heavenly beings called to ascribe glory to the LORD
The voice of the LORD over the waters
The voice that breaks the cedars and strikes with fire
The voice that shakes the wilderness: in his temple all cry glory
The LORD enthroned over the flood gives strength and peace

verses.t: A Psalm of David. Ascribe to the LORD, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.
The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters.
The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.
The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.
The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire.
The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.
The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”
The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.
The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
